subject: Day-of crash plan & strict timebox for guest demos
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Day-of crash plan & strict timebox for guest demos

Hey team,

We landed Olivia for the FinReview webinar on Mar 10 and she wants a hard 10-minute demo window (incl Q&A). Because past guest demos have run long, I want a compact, operational "crash plan" we can hand the host and AV. Goal: shave drift, guarantee transitions, and have escalation paths for technical failure.

Can each of you confirm the following by EOD today: 1) single-line day-of host script that enforces the 10-min timebox, 2) primary and backup AV contact with mobile, 3) the one-sentence fallback we read in case the demo dies, and 4) whether we can shave 90s off the handoff without cutting critical content.

I've attached Olivia's bio and a provisional timing grid. I can draft the host script if you want.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: olivia_bio.docx] [Attachment: timing_grid_15min_slots.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Day-of crash plan & strict timebox for guest demos

Ben —

Quick answers:
- AV primary: Marco Ruiz (Streamline AV) — +1 (415) 555-0189, ops@streamline-av.com
- AV backup: Maya Chen (on-call tech) — +1 (415) 555-0242
- Fallback line: "We’ll move to a screen-share recording and continue with the discussion in Q&A while AV resolves the issue." Short and we can prepend to host script.
- Shave 90s: yes — trim pre-demo anecdote and move 30s of product context to slide notes for the host to speak during transition.

Also: Marco needs an advance run 30 minutes prior to the start to verify screen share and browser permissions. I recommend a 15-min tech check with Olivia at T-45 and a full AV run at T-30.

—Karthik
Director, Production Ops
[Attachment: streamline_av_contact_card.vcf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Day-of crash plan & strict timebox for guest demos

Ben / Karthik —

Drafting the ultra-tight host script now. Things I want to lock before I send a publish-ready one-liner:
- Confirm exact start time (is webinar start 10:00 PT or is that when doors open?)
- Confirm whether Olivia will share a live tab + system audio or present slides only.

If start is 10:00 PT and Olivia has slides, here's a proposed 10-min breakdown (works to the second):
- 0:00–0:30 host intro (30s)
- 0:30–1:10 quick sponsor mention (40s)
- 1:10–1:30 transition to guest (20s)
- 1:30–6:30 guest demo (5:00)
- 6:30–8:30 live Q&A (2:00)
- 8:30–9:30 closing takeaway and CTA (1:00)
- 9:30–10:00 hard stop and handback to host (30s)

That gives the guest 5 minutes demo + 2 minutes Q&A; if Olivia needs the full 10 minutes for demo we flip Q&A to chat-only and surface top questions post-webinar.

I'll push the host script and a "read if demo fails" two-line fallback in the next mail.

—Soojin
Senior Events Producer

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finreview.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Streamline AV <ops@streamline-av.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Day-of crash plan & strict timebox for guest demos

Thanks for the notes — happy to keep things tight. A few clarifications from my side:
- I will present slides and switch to a live tab for the demo (so system audio + screen-share).
- 5 minutes live demo is doable if I focus on one workflow; prefer to keep 2 min for live Q if possible.
- Confirmed for a 15-min tech check at 9:15 PT on Mar 10 (that’s T-45).

I uploaded a short 2-paragraph bio in the doc you attached and added a one-line demo summary. If you want a pre-approved host line, use:
"Please welcome Olivia Chen, Senior Product Lead at FinReview — she’ll walk us through a compact workflow for faster research-to-insight. Olivia, you have five minutes for the demo."

Olivia
Product Lead, FinReview

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finreview.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Streamline AV <ops@streamline-av.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: 10-minute host script and day-of crash plan (for host + Marco)

Team / Olivia —

Attached is the final host script (one line: enforce five-min demo + two-min Q) and a tiny card for Marco with escalation numbers. Summary for day-of printed on host tablet:
- T-45 (9:15) — tech check with Olivia (15m)
- T-30 (9:30) — AV run with Marco (10m)
- T-05 — host cue + go/stop hand signal (see card)
- Demo window: 5:00 demo / 2:00 Q / 1:00 CTA / 30s handback

IF DEMO FAILS (read verbatim):
"We’re switching to a recorded demo while our AV partner reconnects. Olivia will reconvene for questions live in the chat."

Marco / Streamline AV — please confirm you’ll be on the line at T-45 and provide a direct mobile if the stream hiccups.

Thanks — I’ll print the tablet card and send to host + Marco.

Ben
